top_signals.title: India’s New Data Series to Aid RBI Policy, Gupta Says
top_signals.summary: India’s new economic data series will help the Reserve Bank of India make more accurate forecasts of growth and inflation and better calibrate monetary policy, Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said Monday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Jump as Dip Buyers Step In After AI Selloff
top_signals.summary: US stock futures rebounded as dip buyers stepped in following a steep selloff that saw a violent rotation out of technology shares, in a signal of heightened volatility in the artificial intelligence trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Capita Dives 66% as CEO Quits Over Botched Pensions Contract
top_signals.summary: Capita Plc shares plummeted by nearly two-thirds after its chief executive officer stepped down over failings in the outsourcing company’s contract managing Britain’s Civil Service pensions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
